Local landscaping

Landscaping in Camden that suits the block and the street

Camden is a mix like nowhere else in the region: heritage homes with established gardens near the town centre, and brand-new builds handing over bare blocks on the edges. A garden that works on a leafy Camden street is not the same job as a turnkey yard in a new release, so we quote each one on its own merits after seeing the site.

We handle the whole yard under one licence, design through to maintenance, so levels, drainage and planting are planned together. That matters on the Nepean flats, where reactive clay and the odd low-lying block mean drainage has to be right before a single paver goes down.

Get your fixed-price quote

props.label: Built for Camden's soils and streetscapes
props.html:
Why Camden is different

Built for Camden's soils and streetscapes

Heritage-sensitive gardens

Established Camden streets have mature trees and character homes. We work in sympathy with that, matching materials and planting to the setting rather than dropping in something that fights it.

Nepean flat drainage

Lower blocks near the river flats can hold water. We plan falls, ag-drainage and soil conditioning so turf and beds don't sit wet through a Camden winter.

New-estate handover

Building out toward Elderslie or Spring Farm? We do turnkey front and back packages that meet estate design guidelines and clear landscaping bond conditions.

props.label: Section
props.html:
FAQs

Landscaping in Camden: your questions answered

Do you landscape both heritage and new-build homes in Camden?
Yes. We work on established gardens around the Camden town centre and turnkey builds on the newer estates. The approach differs, but the fixed price and no call-out fee are the same on both.
Can you clear a landscaping bond on a new Camden estate block?
Yes, that is a big part of what we do across the growth corridor. We do front and back packages that meet estate design guidelines and bond conditions, so you clear the requirement and get a finished yard.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How soon can you start?
Often quickly, especially for smaller jobs and quotes. We are open 7am to 7pm, 7 days, so call 0451 267 287 and we will tell you honestly what we can do.
